description: Loading placeholder: the kind of content before it arrives, so the layout does not jump when it does. Decorative by design (aria-hidden) — announce the loading state once, on the region, with a <Spinner> or aria-busy, not on every shimmer. The pulse animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: kind
props.description: text = a line of body text (default). block = a rectangular area (card, image). circle = an avatar-sized disc.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of text lines. Only meaningful for kind="text"; the last line is rendered short so the block reads as a paragraph, not a bar. Default 1.

props.name: width
props.description: Width / height overrides for block and circle (a token or length). Text fills its container.

example:
<Row gap={3} aria-busy="true">
  <Skeleton kind="circle" />
  <Stack gap={2} className="skeleton-lines">
    <Skeleton width="12rem" height="1rem" kind="block" />
    <Skeleton lines={3} />
  </Stack>
</Row>
